note: Cause class vocabulary for case.cause_class and harness_incident.class (plan.md 5.4). A class not listed here is an ordering, not a refusal: add it with a description in the same commit as the first case that uses it.

classes.correctly_graded_but_wrong_for_this_inst: the value's grade was right for its source and the value did not hold for this physical part
classes.vendor_spec_vs_bench: a vendor specification was used where the bench value differed
classes.unit_mismatch: a quantity was carried in a unit its consumer did not expect
classes.interface_contract_violation: a tool call or response broke the tool's contract (shape, error contract, timeout)
classes.configuration_not_transferred: a setting shown to a person or a GUI was not what the tool received
classes.missing_permission: an analysis or an action ran without the permission record it needed
classes.inferred_treated_as_observed: an inference was written or used as an observation
classes.stale_snapshot: the envelope snapshot no longer matched the store it was pinned to
classes.unnecessary_question: the wizard asked what the materials had already answered
classes.wrong_inference: a discovered setting was inferred wrongly and a person corrected it
classes.guard_covers_one_route_of_two: a deny rule named one shell and the other shell was open
classes.numerical_instability: a simulation setting violated a stability condition
classes.reference_result_mismatch: a scientific validation task disagreed with its reference beyond the tolerance
classes.tool_unavailable: the tool or its environment could not be reached when needed
classes.held_item_shipped: an item in held[] was found in the bundle
